author: Slidebean
description:
Europe’s final USB C deadline is about to hit laptops, turning one tiny connector into the default port for modern consumer tech. Here’s how USB C quietly replaced a mess of chargers and why that simple looking cable now controls power, data, displays, and a huge accessory business.

👉 Want more breakdowns like this? Check out the Slidebean YouTube channel.
title: This seemingly simple cable just won a 20 year standards war.
